scope: Decision workflow and answer quality; no account mutation
observations: Repeated checks returned empty output before a terminal diagnosis.
Account timestamps and MFA state were treated as stronger password evidence than warranted.
Final credential responses repeated manual file instructions rather than clearly explaining the capability boundary.
changes: Bound empty async checks, prefer one status/exit check, avoid duplicate work and repetitive commentary.
Separate login evidence, private-connector readiness, and explicit password-reset authorization.
Do not infer password change history, correctness or successful authentication from timestamps, MFA or absent exceptions.
Keep secret firewall and report capability gaps plainly without inventing connectors.

real_model_candidate_cases: owner_credential_request: concise capability boundary and available official reset alternative
timestamps_are_not_password_proof: explicitly uncertain until authentication evidence
empty_async_output: requested get_job_status instead of third empty log read

production_http_smoke.review: Explicitly rejected timestamp/MFA/logs as proof of authentication or password-change history.

limits: No private credential connector was implemented in this change.
No actual account password was read, reset or verified.
Behavior guidance and synthetic Q&A do not establish successful login on Laduni.
